email.subject: Quick fix for Comfort Heating & Cooling's site
email.body:
Hi Aisha,

I took a quick look at Comfort Heating & Cooling's website. Two things are likely costing you jobs: there's no way to book or request service online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next HVAC company. And the homepage title doesn't mention HVAC or Harbor Falls, which hurts how you show up in local search results.

Both are fixable without a redesign. I'd like to offer a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd change and why. No pitch, no obligation.

Would a short call this week work?

Alex
